timing: steady_clock wall time; warm caches; model resident; median batch average
clock_control: OS-managed; no fixed CPU frequency or turbo control
power: not measured; base-power or TDP ratings are not workload power
fpga_comparison: OOC cycle-derived 82.07 us at constrained 100 MHz, not measured board latency
frontend_bounds: CPU timings exclude sensor digitization, transfer and host orchestration
